annotation.title_clean: 北京经济技术开发区关于推动具身智能机器人创新发展的若干措施
annotation.title_en: Several Measures of Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area on Promoting the Innovative Development of Embodied Intelligent Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 北京经济技术开发区管理委员会
annotation.venue: 北京经济技术开发区管理委员会 (京技管发〔2025〕17号)
named_instruments_referenced: 人形机器人创新发展指导意见
annotation.summary_en: Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area (Yizhuang) issued ten incentive measures, valid to August 2028, to promote embodied-intelligence robots, including humanoids. It sets 2027 targets and offers subsidies for R&D, real-world datasets, application scenarios, manufacturing, insurance, finance, talent and international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: By end-2027: one secondary-development community, 100+ embodied AI firms, 10,000-unit mass-production capacity, 10M-scale real-world dataset.
Subsidies of up to 2M yuan per firm for datasets, and annual 100M yuan data vouchers at 10% of data purchases.
30%/20% procurement subsidies for scenario providers and robot firms; 100만 yuan per listed first-set equipment.
Humanoid sales subsidy of 10% (up to 1,000 units); 50% insurance premium subsidy up to 1M yuan annually.
Effective on publication until 31 Aug 2028; adjusts with national and Beijing policy changes.
